h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dibrugarh

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dibrugarh

items.pText: Dibrugarh, in Upper Assam, gets some of the heaviest rain we plan for anywhere in India. Tea estates, schools and housing colonies around the town ask us for equipment that can stand outdoors through months of wet weather. FunPlay Systems manufactures everything in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,410 km away, and sends each order to Assam by road.

On a site this far from the factory, careful planning matters more than speed. We go through the layout drawing and the packing list with you before dispatch, so you know exactly what is coming and where each piece will stand. A dealer in the Northeast or our own installation team then installs it. Ask about rubber flooring at the same stage, since sending it with the equipment avoids a second shipment.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: The rains here start early and last for much of the year, and low ground near the Brahmaputra can flood. Raise the play area above the surrounding ground and give it a slope towards a drain. Grouted posts on a concrete base hold better in soft, saturated soil than posts set in earth. Galvanised pipe resists rust and roto-moulded plastic does not absorb water, so both suit a wet climate. Check bolts and spring riders after each monsoon, since springs and bearings need regular care.

items.q: Can you deliver playground equipment to Upper Assam?
items.a: Yes. We send orders from our Vasai factory to Dibrugarh by road. Installation is done by our own team or by a dealer who serves the Northeast.

items.q: What should a tea estate school consider for its playground?
items.a: Plan a raised, well-drained base, choose galvanised and roto-moulded equipment, and keep the play zone clear of open drains and slopes. We can suggest pieces for the age groups in your school.

items.q: Is wooden play equipment suitable for Dibrugarh?
items.a: Our wooden and composite ranges need more care in a climate this wet. For most sites here we suggest galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic, which do not rot or soak up water.
